title: You Took Pity On Me, And Blessed
summary: Gratitude is being answered in the middle of pressure, not after the day has calmed down.
takeaway: I have not appreciated what You have done for me, Lord; only; you took pity on me, and blessed me with Your Mercy, and
lifeApplication: Let one received thing become a place of praise instead of entitlement. Use the line before the pressure chooses your tone.

source.shortMeaning: I have not appreciated what You have done for me, Lord; only; you took pity on me, and blessed me with Your Mercy, and
source.lifeApplication: Let the wider line hold together what the mind wants to split apart.
